summary_1line: Rama visits Dasharatha, sees his distress, and Kaikeyi reveals her demand: Bharata’s coronation and Rama’s fourteen‑year exile to honor the king’s old promise.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama bows at the feet of the pale, grief‑stricken King Dasharatha who sits speechless beside the stern Kaikeyi on the royal couch.
Kaikeyi coldly declares Rama’s exile while the devastated king weeps silently, unable to look at his son.
Calm and resolute, Rama vows to obey his father even if it means fire, poison, or the sea, standing before the trembling king.
